name: Kokuchounuma Shie
source:
A mischievous and clever inhabitant of EDEN. She loves pranks and confusing people. Her favourite "subject" to tease is [url=/c56949]Niwaka[/url]. 

She has a bewitching aura around her. Some people call her an actual witch, or sometimes an Esper.

[Based on the [url=http://product.hobibox.net/nobrandxxx/if/chara15.html]official description[/url]]
